get_code_size_flat: get the code size in bytes for a Flat index with a given dimension d
get_code_size_pq: get the code size in bytes for a PQ index key like PQ64x8 using get_code_size
get_code_size_ivf: get the code size for an IVF index key such as IVF100,PQ32x8 with get_code_size
reverse_index_factory_ivfpq: reverse engineer the factory string from a built faiss IndexIVFPQ index using reverse_index_factory
reverse_index_factory_scalar_quantizer: reverse engineer the factory string from a faiss IndexScalarQuantizer index using reverse_index_factory
